ABOUT US

We don't just install solar. We create a smarter way to power life.

At Amaravati Solar Solutions, we believe the future of energy should be efficient, dependable, and sustainable. Our approach combines thoughtful solar system design, quality components, precision installation, and end-to-end customer support to deliver solutions built around the needs of every customer.

Our Mission

  • To make the transition to solar simple, seamless, and worthwhile. To accelerate the transition towards clean energy by making solar power accessible and reliable, reducing environmental impact, and inspiring communities to embrace a greener, more sustainable future.
  • Together, building a greener society for generations to come.

Our Vision

  • To redefine the way people experience energy.
  • We envision a future where every suitable rooftop becomes a source of clean power, every household has greater control over its energy costs, and sustainability becomes a natural part of everyday living.
  • Our ambition is to build a trusted solar brand that stands for engineering excellence, lasting reliability, and a cleaner tomorrow.

Our values

What guides our work

Quality

We use dependable components and follow careful installation practices.

Honesty

Clear advice and transparent quotations, always.

Sustainability

Helping more people move to clean, renewable power.

Customer support

Quality and support, beyond installation

From your first call to years after commissioning, our team is available to answer questions, inspect your system and provide maintenance assistance.

Our approach

Consultation to commissioning

  • 1. Understand your needs in a free consultation
  • 2. Inspect your site and assess energy use
  • 3. Share a customised, transparent proposal
  • 4. Install professionally and support you ongoing

Smart, reliable and sustainable solar energy solutions for homes, commercial complexes, and industrial installations across India.
